datasheet: /home/user/OpenAIO-Whoop/research/DESIGN-SPEC.md §1 'Ears and holes' (Ø 3.5 on a 25.75 mm square, ring OD 4.8 = ear), §7 outline table (holes, Ø 5.2 grommet flange part keepout both sides), O2/O16; DRU 'NPTH at least 0.50'
derivation: non-plated hole Ø 3.50 as an NPTH pad (no copper; KiCad mounting-hole form), F.Fab hole outline as body, F.Fab Ø 5.2 circle for the flange, footprint rule area Ø 5.2 on F.Cu + B.Cu keeping other footprints out (same as the board's MOUNT_* areas), courtyard = hole + 0.10 on both sides (the flange keepout is the rule area, not the courtyard). The P1 board cuts the holes as Edge.Cuts circles: P2 keeps either those or this pad, never both (REPORT). Plated GND-annulus variant (O16): annulus OD <= 4.4 (ear OD 4.8 - 2 x 0.20 copper-to-edge)
